div.head: VIII Atr 31
div.ab: Ac we lærað georne ⁊ luflice biddað, þæt ælces hades men þam life libban, þe heom to gebirige.
Ac we lærað georne ⁊ luflice biddað, þæt ælces hades men þam life libban þe heom to gebirige.
Ac we lærað georne and luflice biddað þæt ælces hades men þam life libban þe heom to gebirige.
Sondern wir weisen ernstlich an und bitten freundschaftlich, dass Menschen jeden Standes in solcher Lebensweise leben, welche ihnen gebührt.
But we earnestly instruct and lovingly ask that people of every order live the life that befits them.
But we earnestly enjoin and, with all good-will, beg men of every estate to live such a life as befits them.
But we eagerly direct and lovingly pray that men in every order will lead the life which belongs to them.
But we fervently instruct and lovingly beseech those of every class to conduct their lives in the manner most fitting for them.
